name: Villanova d'Albenga (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanova d'Albenga (a red castle on yellow beneath fruit) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Villanova d'Albenga, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Villanova d'Albenga arms — red castle on yellow beneath fruit, crowned, within branches
